_comment: Channel narrator. Changing voice/speed here changes it for every future video; keep it fixed for consistency.

pronunciations._comment: single capital A next to another point letter (A B, A C, B A) is the letter, not the article
capital A after a lowercase word or comma (point A, centres A, angle at A) is the letter; sentence-initial A stays the article
lowercase variable a in 'a equals' is the letter
